in_sanskrit.name: मण्डूका
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: The name Manjula is derived from the Sanskrit word मण्डूक (mṇḍūka), which means lotus. In Hindu mythology, the lotus is a symbol of creation, purity, and divine beauty. Manjula is a beautiful and meaningful name for a baby girl.
